pr_title: [mono] Hot Reload: initial push to support adding lambdas
pr_body:
Adds support for:
* Adding static lambdas to existing methods, whether or not they had lambdas before.
* Adding lambdas that capture `this` to existing methods that already captured `this` before
* Adding new static or instance methods to existing types
* Adding static fields to existing types
* Adding new types (note that adding instance fields currently will fail.  It'll go in in a future PR that will address https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/63643).

Note that reflection on newly added members isn't tested yet and likely doesn't work.

Fixes #50249

Contributes to https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/57365

issue_context.title: [mbr] hot reload doesn't work on lambda bodies
issue_context.body:
### Description

The hot reload feature seems to work a lot better on `Index.razor` than on certain other files. I'm not sure why the behavior differs.

Steps:

* Use latest preview 3 SDK
* `dotnet new blazorwasm -o MyApp`
* `cd MyApp`
* `dotnet watch`
* When the app is running, modify some text in `Pages/Index.razor` - see it appears correctly in the browser
* Now try a similar edit inside `Shared/NavMenu.razor`, for example change the text `Home` to `Home2`.
  * Expected: change is applied
  * Actual: runtime crashes

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1101362/112522487-9a1a7200-8d95-11eb-883a-ef1a265afc74.png)

### Configuration

This is with SDK 6.0.100-preview.3.21173.6, with `Microsoft.NETCoreSdk.BundledVersions.props` patched to use the runtime version 6.0.0-preview.4.21174.4.

cc @lambdageek

Thanks for clarifying! That makes sense. Glad to hear there’s a plan to support this eventually too. 

RenderFragments are extremely common in Blazor, so it would definitely be super valuable to support editing them.

Emitting new lambdas is going to be 7.

Updating the bodies of existing lambdas might happen in 6 - there are some circumstances where `dotnet watch`+Roslyn emit a delta that puts an updated lambda body into a new method where in CI we see Roslyn update an existing lambda body.  We should be able to get `dotnet watch`+Roslyn to update existing lambdas, too.

Updating of existing lambda bodies that are generated from .razor pages will become supported once https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/pull/55407 makes it into the dotnet SDK.

Adding new lambdas will be .net 7

Adding new lambdas (either static lambdas that don't capture anything, or new lambdas that capture `this` when there is already at least one lambda that captures `this`, or lambdas that capture locals (as long as there's already at least one lambda that captures the same locals) will be supported in the first preview of .NET 7 (Fixed in #63513).

review_comments: N.B `NewTypeDefinition` is only partially supported.  Adding new instance fields doesn't work yet.  That's https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/63643
